# Which Ink Fits

> Which Ink Fits (whichinkfits.com) lists the ink, toner, and bottle numbers HP, Canon, Epson, and Brother publish for a printer model, and the printers a number fits. Checked 16 Nov 2026.

Independent. Not affiliated with any printer maker. Confirm the number on the manufacturer page.

## Guides
- [Find the model number](https://whichinkfits.com/guides/find-the-model-number/)
- [Ink cartridge, toner, or bottle?](https://whichinkfits.com/guides/ink-toner-or-bottle/)
- [Why HP cartridge numbers differ outside the US](https://whichinkfits.com/guides/hp-cartridge-numbers-by-region/)
- [How HP Instant Ink counts a page](https://whichinkfits.com/guides/hp-instant-ink/)
- [XL vs standard page yields](https://whichinkfits.com/guides/xl-vs-standard-cartridges/)
- [Sources and methods](https://whichinkfits.com/methodology/)
